checkConnection: Check your connection and try again.
serverUnreachable: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
micBlocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it for this site, or type your answer.
micBlockedFixTitle: Microphone is blocked for this site — no allow/block prompt will reappear until you change it in browser settings
micBlockedFix1: Click the padlock/shield icon at the left of the address bar → Site settings
micBlockedFix2: Turn Microphone on (Allowed). Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Site settings → Microphone → move this site from “Not allowed” to “Allowed”
micBlockedFix3: On Mac, also check System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone → make sure your browser is switched on
sttStopped: Speech recognition stopped. Try again, or type your answer.
sttCouldNotStart: Speech recognition could not start. Type your answer instead.
voiceUnavailable: Voice input isn’t available in this browser. Type instead.
transcribeFailed: We could not transcribe that. Type your answer instead.
micCouldNotStart: The microphone could not start. Type your answer instead.
sectionDidNotLoad: This section didn’t load. Your work is saved — try again, or head back home.
